newsitem.title: USA: Freeport Resource sets final preferential payout.
newsitem.headline: Freeport Resource sets final preferential payout.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners LP said Friday it has declared the final cash distribution under the preferential rights granted in connection with the February 1992 offering of its units.
A distribution pf $0.60 per unit will be paid February 15 to holders of record on January 31.

In connection with the offering of Freeport Resource units, the partnership said, it committed for a five-year period to providing public unitholders a preferential right to receive quarterly distributions of up to $0.60 per unit before paying any distributions to its managing general partner, Freeport-McMoRan Inc.

In the future, cash distributions to public unitholders will be determined by available distributable cash resulting from operations of the partnership and the terms of the partnership agreement. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
